name: seqlens_expand
description: Build the per-token KV-cache position list for a speculative extend batch. extend_seq_lens and seq_lens are one-dimensional int32 arrays; the result has total_len int32 elements laid out by concatenating requests in order. For request i occupying output rows [exclusive_cumsum(extend_seq_lens)[i], +extend_seq_lens[i]), out[pos] = max(seq_lens[i] - extend_seq_lens[i] + 1 + local_pos, 0). Returns a newly allocated int32 tensor and does not mutate inputs. max_q_len is accepted for API compatibility but does not affect the computation. Suites exercise int32 lengths with total_len equal to sum(extend_seq_lens).
